description: This repository provides an opinionated tutorial on building Kubernetes controllers, sharing best practices and design patterns I have found most effective

summary.one_liner: An opinionated tutorial series on building Kubernetes controllers with Kubebuilder, covering CRDs, reconcilers, concurrency, long-running operations, CRD versioning, and testing.
summary.what_it_does: The README introduces itself as an opinionated guide to building Kubernetes controllers, drawing on the author's experience maintaining the Kubernetes add-on controller and K8s-cleaner projects. It states that Kubebuilder is used to create the new APIs and controllers. The listed table of contents covers CustomResourceDefinitions, the Reconciler, concurrent reconciling, handling long-running operations in reconcilers, versioning CRDs, and testing a controller. The README text provided is only the introduction and table of contents, so the details of each topic are not visible here.
use_cases: learning to write a Kubernetes controller
understanding CRD and reconciler design patterns
